scenarios.title: A｜支持其中一方
scenarios.setting: 玩家的两个朋友 Emma 和 Lily 吵架。Emma 私下告诉玩家发生了什么。

turns.text: I can’t believe she did that. You understand why I’m angry, right?

turns.prompt: 你想支持朋友，认可对方生气的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. Honestly, I think you have every right to be upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. Honestly, I think you have every right to be upset.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: From what you’ve told me, I understand your side.

feedback.naturalExpression: From what you’ve told me, I understand your side.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I think she crossed a line this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think she crossed a line this time.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: If that happened the way you described it, I’d be upset too.

feedback.naturalExpression: If that happened the way you described it, I’d be upset too.
feedback.explanation: 用“If”保留事实尚待核实的前提，同时承认在这种情况下生气可以理解。

choices.text: You’re completely right and she’s completely wrong.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. Honestly, I think you have every right to be upset.
feedback.explanation: 只听一方就说对方完全正确，容易把共情变成站队；认可感受不必替事实下结论。

turns.text: Exactly. Everyone keeps telling me I’m overreacting.

turns.prompt: 你想认可朋友的感受，给予支持，会怎么说？

choices.text: I don’t think you’re overreacting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think you’re overreacting.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Your feelings make sense to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Your feelings make sense to me.
feedback.explanation: “feelings make sense”表示理解对方为什么有这样的感受，不必因此认同每个判断。

choices.text: I think what she did was unfair.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think what she did was unfair.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I support you, but I still think you two should eventually talk about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I support you, but I still think you two should eventually talk about it.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

turns.text: Maybe. I’m definitely not ready to talk to her today.

turns.prompt: 你想回应朋友暂时不想沟通的决定，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fair. Give yourself some time.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. Give yourself some time.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: You don’t have to sort everything out immediately.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t have to sort everything out immediately.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Take some time to cool off first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Take some time to cool off first.
feedback.explanation: “cool off”表示冷静下来，适合在情绪强烈时提出暂缓讨论。

scenarios.title: B｜保持中立
scenarios.setting: 之后 Lily 也来找玩家。

turns.text: Emma told you what happened, didn’t she? Whose side are you on?

turns.prompt: 对方想了解出了什么问题，你会怎样说明情况？

choices.text: Honestly, I don’t want to take sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I don’t want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: You’re both my friends, and I don’t think it’s my place to choose between you.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re both my friends, and I don’t think it’s my place to choose between you.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’ve heard both sides, and I think the situation is more complicated than that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve heard both sides, and I think the situation is more complicated than that.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I care about both of you. I’d rather not turn this into teams.

feedback.naturalExpression: I care about both of you. I’d rather not turn this into teams.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I’m standing in the middle.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I don’t want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: “standing in the middle”是站在空间中间；表示保持中立用“staying neutral”。

turns.text: But you must think one of us is more wrong than the other.

turns.prompt: 关于「两个朋友要求自己站队」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I have opinions about what happened, but that doesn’t mean I need to pick a side.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have opinions about what happened, but that doesn’t mean I need to pick a side.
feedback.explanation: “pick a side”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: I think both of you did things that made the situation worse.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think both of you did things that made the situation worse.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I understand why you’re both upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand why you’re both upset.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I’d rather help you two work things out than decide who’s the bad guy.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather help you two work things out than decide who’s the bad guy.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: So you’re not going to tell me what Emma said?

turns.prompt: 你想说明不替另一方转述私下谈话的界限，会怎么说？

choices.text: No. If she wants you to know, she should tell you herself.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. If she wants you to know, she should tell you herself.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I’d rather not repeat a private conversation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not repeat a private conversation.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I don’t think sharing what she told me would help.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think sharing what she told me would help.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

scenarios.title: C｜拒绝参与
scenarios.setting: 争执持续了几天，两个人不断向玩家抱怨对方，玩家决定退出。

turns.text: Did Lily tell you what she said about me yesterday?

turns.prompt: 关于「两个朋友要求自己站队」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I think I need to stay out of this from now on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I need to stay out of this from now on.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I care about both of you, but I don’t want to be in the middle anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I care about both of you, but I don’t want to be in the middle anymore.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: I’m happy to support you as a friend, but I can’t keep passing messages between you two.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to support you as a friend, but I can’t keep passing messages between you two.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I think you need to talk to Lily directly instead of through me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think you need to talk to Lily directly instead of through me.
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

turns.text: I’m not asking you to pass messages. I just need someone to talk to.

turns.prompt: 你想在回应对方的同时，说明自己仍有顾虑，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but it’s becoming uncomfortable for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but it’s becoming uncomfortable for me.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I can listen to how you’re feeling, but I don’t want to discuss Lily behind her back.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can listen to how you’re feeling, but I don’t want to discuss Lily behind her back.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I want to support you without becoming part of the conflict.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to support you without becoming part of the conflict.
feedback.explanation: 同时说明愿意支持和不想卷入冲突的界限，避免把关心等同于选边站。

choices.text: We can talk about how you’re doing, but I’d rather not analyze everything Lily says or does.

feedback.naturalExpression: We can talk about how you’re doing, but I’d rather not analyze everything Lily says or does.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Okay. I didn’t realize it was putting you in that position.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for understanding.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I just don’t want this situation to damage my friendship with either of you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just don’t want this situation to damage my friendship with either of you.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I hope you two can work it out, but I need to step back from the conflict.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hope you two can work it out, but I need to step back from the conflict.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I’m still here for you. I just need that boundary.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still here for you. I just need that boundary.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。
